hero.lead: A nation of 9.2 million in the Alps, with forest across almost half its land and eight tenths of its power renewable, whose debt agency plans €43 to €47 billion of federal bonds in 2026.

capital.heading: A Republic its citizens lend to directly.

record.text: Saved in Bundesschatz, the federal savings product, after two years, across more than 170,000 accounts
record.source: Federal Ministry of Finance of Austria, 2026

record.text: General government gross debt, share of GDP, 2025

register.name: Federal bonds, 2026
register.detail: Austrian Federal Financing Agency (OeBFA) · Annual review 2025, April 2026
register.text: Planned issuance of federal bonds, with a rise of €2 to €4 billion in short-term instruments.

register.name: Bundesschatz
register.text: A savings product through which citizens and public bodies lend directly to the Republic; almost €2 billion is in green Bundesschatz.

assets.heading: Five assets no balance sheet counts.

items.name: The Forest
items.label: Of the land under forest, 2024
items.text: Standing forest that stores carbon and water, and can earn as it stands.

items.name: The Clean Grid
items.label: Of electricity from renewable sources, 2021
items.text: Power from water, wind and sun already flows; every new connection can be clean.

items.name: The Fresh Water
items.label: Renewable fresh water a person, 2022
items.text: Rain and rivers renewed every year: power, irrigation and drinking water.

items.name: The People
items.label: Citizens, 2025
items.text: 14.1% are under fifteen: the workforce and the market of the next generation.

items.name: The Farmland
items.label: Of the land in agriculture, 2023
items.text: Land that can feed the nation and earn abroad, valued and financed against its harvest.
